entries.lead: Unused timers and timeout settings removed
entries.text: benchbox.utils no longer exports TimeoutManager, get_timeout_manager, timeout, TimeoutConfig, TimeoutError or run_with_timeout, and ResourceLimitsConfig no longer has default_operation_timeout or enforce_timeouts; none of them limited a run. Three configuration keys that promised a limit and enforced nothing are removed: benchmarks.timeout_minutes, execution.power_run.timeout_per_iteration_minutes and execution.concurrent_queries.query_timeout_seconds.
details: A configuration file that still sets one of the three keys loads, prints '`<key>` is no longer used and has no effect. Use `execution.timeout_seconds` to limit a run.', and the key is ignored.
Use execution.timeout_seconds (or --timeout) to limit a whole run; 0 means no limit.
ExecutionConfigHelper and its power run and concurrent query settings no longer carry the two removed timeout values, and the performance profiles and optimize_for_system no longer set them.
Plan capture keeps plan_capture_timeout_seconds with its 30-second default and is now also bounded by the time left on the run.
